Tarun Reddy
Backend Engineer focused on distributed systems | Thane West
tarun.reddy939@example.com | +91 9182598198

Summary
Go developer with experience building and operating high-throughput backend services for consumer platforms. Strong focus on reliability, observability, and SQL schema design to deliver measurable latency and cost improvements. Available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience

Dream11 — Jan 2025 - Present
Go Developer | Remote
- Implemented new betting settlement service in Go with Postgres-backed transaction store, reducing settlement latency by 40% and lowering peak DB write contention by 30%.
- Containerized service and deployed to Kubernetes with automated rolling updates and readiness probes, achieving zero-downtime releases across multi-AZ clusters.
- Introduced Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for request latency and resource usage, cutting mean-time-to-detect incidents by 50%.
- Led Postgres schema refactor and partitioning strategy for time-series events, improving query performance for analytics pipelines and reducing storage costs.

CartNest — Nov 2024 - Dec 2024
Platform Engineer | Onsite
- Built gRPC service gateway in Go to consolidate internal RPCs, reducing inter-service call overhead and simplifying client libraries.
- Designed Postgres migration and connection pooling plan to support bursty checkout traffic, decreasing connection errors during peak tests by 70%.
- Packaged microservices with Docker and defined Kubernetes manifests for developer environments, shortening onboarding time for new engineers.
- Wrote Confluence runbooks documenting deployment steps and incident playbooks to standardize platform operations.

Ola — Jun 2022 - Oct 2024
Backend Engineer | Hybrid
- Owned core ride-matching gRPC APIs implemented in Go, optimizing RPC payloads and reducing average RPC latency by 25%.
- Led Postgres performance tuning and indexing efforts for trip history and billing tables, cutting slow queries by 60% and improving report generation times.
- Deployed services on Kubernetes with resource requests/limits and HPA policies, lowering infrastructure costs while maintaining SLOs.
- Instrumented services with Prometheus and alerts, driving a 35% reduction in P1 incidents through proactive detection and automated remediation scripts.

Projects
- Real-time Metrics Aggregator: Go service that ingests Prometheus-style metrics, aggregates, and writes summarized data to Postgres; deployed in Docker for local testing.
- gRPC Mock Framework: Lightweight Go library to mock gRPC server behavior for unit and integration tests, used to speed up CI feedback loops.

Skills
Languages: Go
Stack: gRPC, Kubernetes, Docker
Datastores & Observability: Postgres, Prometheus
Documentation & Processes: Confluence

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad

Notice period: 30 days
